daemon_interval.description: Interval in seconds between service checks (global daemon polling interval).

eventqueue_basedir.description: Base directory for the event queue storage.

eventqueue_enabled.description: Enable event queue to buffer and batch alerts (e.g., for rate-limiting).

eventqueue_slots.description: Maximum number of queued events before oldest are dropped.

httpd_allow_addr.description: IP address or CIDR subnet allowed to access the web interface (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.0/24').

httpd_allow_password.description: Password for HTTP basic authentication (required if username is set).

httpd_allow_username.description: Username for HTTP basic authentication (optional, set both username and password to require login).

httpd_enabled.description: Enable/disable the built-in HTTP server for the web interface.

httpd_port.description: Port for the Monit web interface (only if HTTP daemon is enabled).

include_dirs.description: List of include paths. If empty, defaults to '/etc/monit/conf.d/*'.

items.description: Path to include additional Monit configuration files or directories (e.g., '/etc/monit/conf.d/*').

log_path.description: Path to the monit log file. If empty or omitted, defaults to syslog.

mail_alerts.description: List of email addresses to receive alert notifications.

items.description: Email address to receive Monit alerts.

mail_from.description: Email 'From' address for alerts (optional, may be required by some MTAs).

mail_server.description: SMTP server hostname or IP for sending alert emails (optional).

mail_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for SMTP connections.

pidfile.description: Path to the Monit PID file.

service_check_interval.description: Per-service default check interval (can be overridden in service blocks).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use if logging to syslog (e.g., 'daemon', 'user', 'local0').

umask.description: Umask for Monit processes (e.g., '077' for restrictive permissions).
